caption: The $1K Challenge is $75, one time, at the link in my bio. It gives you 30 consecutive days and one goal: $1,000 in total revenue. You get your personal $1K Plan with your number and what to do each week, 25 Reel ideas every week, 30 carousel and 30 Story templates, a Notion content tracker, a guide to auto-posting with your AI, and the full $1K Club Playbook. Prefer to go at your own pace? The $1K Club is $40 and gives you the plan to keep.
